definitionTexts.term-c62d422486cfa7fa: An official who presides over administrative hearings.

definitionTexts.term-8b4808bc7afd13bf: The process of involving the public in decision-making activities.

Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo overruled this doctrine in 2024; courts must exercise independent judgment on statutory meaning.

Wilkie: a court may defer to an agency's reasonable interpretation of its own genuinely ambiguous regulation only if the interpretation is authoritative, reflects relevant expertise and fair, considered judgment, and avoids unfair surprise.

definitionTexts.term-b8495ee3681c5fc6: An official responsible for oversight, audits, and investigations within a government agency.
definitionTexts.term-1da4f38244dc9b19: A daily publication that contains proposed and final regulations, executive orders, and other government documents.

definitionTexts.term-851d99ad9c72d5a9: The requirement that legal proceedings be fair and that individuals be given notice and an opportunity to be heard.

definitionTexts.term-df72faf52f9b2343: A legal document ordering someone to attend a court proceeding or produce evidence.
definitionTexts.term-237078b49987a17b: A principle allowing courts to protect certain fundamental rights from government interference even if procedural protections are present.
definitionTexts.term-61bd754dd433c07b: Regulations issued by an administrative agency that have the force and effect of law.
definitionTexts.term-4ab3d13a9c6701ac: A provision that sets an expiration date for a law or regulation unless further legislative action is taken.

definitionTexts.term-53887b7d3ed116cf: Acts conducted beyond the scope of legal power or authority.
definitionTexts.term-aba9d39e0a1c003f: Legal protections for individuals who report illegal or unethical conduct within an organization.

definitionTexts.term-8cf1bb349c0f5bde: A law or regulation that defines how property in specific geographic zones can be used.

definitionTexts.term-a5f007b7786ca0fe: Evidence that is allowed to be presented in court.
definitionTexts.term-13091dc0e35c123a: A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation used as evidence in court.

definitionTexts.term-c8b33dd0a11136d3: A document issued by a judge or magistrate that authorizes the police to take someone into custody.

definitionTexts.term-37ee1f6eff282aee: Money or property that is deposited with the court to ensure that the defendant will appear in court as required.

definitionTexts.term-7a35616106278567: The killing of one person by another, which can be classified as murder, manslaughter, or justifiable homicide depending on circumstances.

definitionTexts.term-53e562076e93ae15: A formal written or spoken statement given in a court of law.

definitionTexts.term-4c4ffb11cd5fd067: A legal authorization for police to make an arrest, conduct a search, or seize property.

definitionTexts.term-38ce100b58a18740: A conviction of a person for a crime they did not commit.

definitionTexts.term-d29bfd57c10226db: A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation used as evidence in court.
definitionTexts.term-27710b78d55aa33b: Financial support paid to an ex-spouse after divorce, often determined by court order.

definitionTexts.term-e7b4c41a910b3fd7: The act of entering another's land without permission, leading to potential legal liability for damages.
definitionTexts.term-1da52341fb527978: A situation where one party benefits at the expense of another in an unfair manner, often leading to restitution or other remedies.

nodes.fallback: Historical doctrine: the U.S. Supreme Court overruled Chevron deference on June 28, 2024 in Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo. Courts must exercise independent judgment when interpreting statutes. The displayed definition identifies the doctrine as historical; the original manuscript is preserved separately.

nodes.label: Manslaughter
nodes.fallback: US federal-law clarification: 18 USC 1112 defines manslaughter as unlawful killing without malice. Its voluntary branch covers a sudden quarrel or heat of passion; its involuntary branch covers specified unlawful acts or culpably careless lawful acts. Lack of premeditation alone does not distinguish manslaughter from murder: 18 USC 1111 also recognizes second-degree murder. The displayed definition now distinguishes manslaughter from murder; the original manuscript is preserved separately. The two source-attested Mongolian statutory descriptions are separately qualified study pathways for the voluntary and involuntary branches, not a claim that the national offenses, defenses or penalties are identical.

nodes.label: Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act (UCCJEA)
nodes.fallback: Jurisdiction correction: the UCCJEA is a uniform state law adopted through state legislation, not a federal statute. It addresses jurisdiction and recognition/enforcement of child custody orders. The displayed definition identifies this as a uniform state act; the original manuscript is preserved separately.

The receiving/acquiring role is explicitly distinguished from the transferor in a real-property conveyance documented under article 109.2. The qualified descriptive expression preserves the original deed-context meaning, rather than importing an aid recipient. It is a functional role equivalent, not a claim that national conveyance formalities are identical. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-0371863c3826d34d.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=299 ; Civil Code articles 153.1–153.2 and related secured-right provisions. Article 153 identifies the secured creditor who holds the property security right and has priority recovery from the collateral. This matches the holder of the lien concept already translated as барьцааны эрх. The word also has other contexts, including a hostage taker; every listed form therefore requires selection of the civil secured-creditor interpretation. The collateral provider барьцаалуулагч is not substituted. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-f2e9847fa139410c.source: https://www.mongolbank.mn/file/files/documents/MB_sanhuu28.pdf ; https://www.aic.mn/%D1%85%D2%AF%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9-%D0%BD%D3%A9%D3%A9%D1%86/ ; Central-bank journal PDF pages 76–90, retirement-plan article; insurer HR policy retirement accounts. The ministry-authored research describes pension programs, contributions, funding and retirement income. The employer’s published HR policy independently describes pension accounts established for employees to provide financial security after retirement. The original definition remains unchanged; no claim is made that every national pension system is an employer plan. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-d4a6b1e1fbfeea68.source: https://www.aic.mn/%D1%85%D2%AF%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9-%D0%BD%D3%A9%D3%A9%D1%86/ ; Published employer HR policy, Хөнгөлөлт хангамж, pension-account and health-insurance provisions. The policy identifies employer-provided retirement accounts and employee health/accident insurance, matching nonwage benefits in the original definition. The unqualified phrase requires selection of the employment interpretation. Accounting-standard employee benefits and a separate HR survey also include salary or pay increases; those broader labels are deliberately not activated as exact equivalents of this nonwage entry. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-5ffe7175edda107a.source: https://frc.mn/resource/frc/Document/2022/12/26/dae6ca33q84duw1m/Sanhuugiin%20SUDALGAANII%20EMHETGEL__2022%20final.pdf ; FRC research PDF pages 76–77, US OTC-market regulation. The regulator research identifies the SEC’s enforcement of securities legislation and regulation of US brokers and dealers. The country-qualified expression goes directly to the original federal-agency entry; the generic commission label requires confirmation because other jurisdictions have similarly named agencies. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-d07d1a340ea92405.text: компанид учруулсан хохирлыг нөхөн төлүүлэх хувьцаа эзэмшигчийн нэхэмжлэл
term-d07d1a340ea92405.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=310 ; https://portal.num.edu.mn/Staff/069e9583-507b-43f1-8a38-ca85dcba9a5e/Publications ; Company Law articles 84.7 and 86.1; NUM author’s 2023 comparative publication abstract. The original research abstract expressly calls these provisions shareholder derivative suits and identifies claims on behalf of the company. The qualified phrase concerns corporate injury, not a shareholder’s personal loss. The broader shareholder-claim alias requires selection of the derivative context. Local standing, cost-recovery and enforcement rules are not asserted to be identical across jurisdictions. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-99882a3e3141454e.text: компанийн нийт хувьцааны талаас илүүг эзэмшигч
term-99882a3e3141454e.source: https://legaldata.mn/index.php/b/1597 ; Original corporate-law research, public explanation of majority/minority shareholder terminology. The research cautions that the native term may denote control even with a small percentage in a dispersed company. That broader usage is not silently equated with the original entry’s ownership above 50 percent. The primary phrase preserves the book’s narrower legal context; the broader alias requires reading and selecting that definition, rather than automatically assigning it. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-a13faeab8f9102cd.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 5, introduction; pages 9–12, commercial protection decisions. The introduction expressly integrates technology and patent strategy into business, marketing and export strategy; subsequent pages discuss market position, licensing, investment and protection choices. The primary modern genitive and lemma are editorial normalization of the attested older inflected spelling, not a claimed verbatim quotation. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-3aaf92eab293fcb0.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF pages 14–15, patentability criteria and eligible/excluded subject matter. The eligibility criterion is distinct from novelty and inventive step on page 14; page 15 explains eligible subject matter through exclusions. Restored the noun lemma from the attested accusative. The guide warns that national subject-matter boundaries vary. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-919f7b165a15300d.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 30, box headed Патент хүлээгдэх. The box explicitly describes product labels with these phrases and application numbers before rights are obtained. It distinguishes a filed application from an issued patent and cautions that the words themselves do not create enforceable protection. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-4acbd18d7808ed70.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 30, box headed Патент хүлээгдэх. The box explicitly describes product labels with these phrases and application numbers before rights are obtained. It distinguishes a filed application from an issued patent and cautions that the words themselves do not create enforceable protection. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-1f961c74805cbdfa.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 30, box headed Патент хүлээгдэх. The box explicitly describes product labels with these phrases and application numbers before rights are obtained. It distinguishes a filed application from an issued patent and cautions that the words themselves do not create enforceable protection. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-588615e9e4013d93.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 17, life-sciences patent box, final paragraph; compare page 11 plant-variety rights. The source expressly distinguishes patents for new plant varieties from a separate plant-variety protection system and notes jurisdictional differences. This descriptive expression restores the patent noun and protection relationship from the sentence; it does not equate a variety certificate with a patent or claim identical national eligibility rules. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-170af701e3279400.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF page 17, practical use and usefulness explanation. A qualified descriptive expression for the original patentability requirement that an invention be useful. The source distinguishes a merely theoretical phenomenon from useful practical operation. This is not the separate utility-model right and does not assert that US utility and every jurisdiction’s industrial-applicability test are identical. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-c569c07b16b6a6c8.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=16231112526381 ; Patent Law article 49 heading and 49.1–49.2. Article 49 identifies challenges to an improperly granted patent, including failed patentability criteria and excluded subject matter. Nonpayment/expiry under article 41 is deliberately not imported as an equivalent. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-ec945bada4c7974c.text: анхдагч огнооноос өмнө ашиглаж байсан үндэслэлээр патентын зөрчлөөс хамгаалах
term-ec945bada4c7974c.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=16231112526381 ; Patent Law articles 48.1.5 and 48.2, prior-use exception. Descriptive legal expression combining the attested prior-use condition with its express statutory consequence: conduct is not a patent infringement. The book’s prior-use defense is preserved; the source’s additional good-faith, territorial, preparation and nontransferability conditions are not asserted to be identical across jurisdictions. No unattested standardized short label is claimed. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-543c6bae954ce6d2.text: патентын мэдүүлэгт өөрчлөлт оруулах шаардлагын тухай шинжээчийн мэдэгдэл
term-543c6bae954ce6d2.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=16231112526381 ; Patent Law articles 25.6 and 25.8–25.9. Source-supported descriptive equivalent for an examiner’s formal notification raising application issues. The patent/application/examiner qualifiers are restored from the same provision. Generic office correspondence is excluded; this does not claim identical domestic and US procedural categories. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-ebf2a748b5637e80.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=16231112526381 ; Patent Law articles 24.6–24.8 and 25.3. The qualified descriptive date expression combines the patent-application subject and public publication event in the provisions. It is not a filing, priority or grant date. The generic publication date of an unrelated book is excluded; no verbatim standardized headword is claimed. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-11146517569cf144.source: https://www.uih.mn/upload/sudalgaa/files/450_5845627.pdf ; Parliament Secretariat original research collection I (2009), PDF pages 264–265, US legislation table. The bilingual table identifies the US federal statute. Restored the explicit US context in the primary expression; a jurisdiction-free title requires confirmation. The manuscript’s original plural English headword is preserved; the cited official title uses singular Procedure. This is not Mongolia’s Administrative General Law. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-5c495076dd86e5b1.source: https://www.uih.mn/upload/sudalgaa/files/450_5845627.pdf ; Same collection PDF pages 264–265, US environmental legislation table; NLI 2022 journal PDF page 95. The bilingual original table explicitly identifies the federal water-pollution statute; NLI separately discusses US water-discharge regulation. The US qualifier prevents confusion with unrelated domestic water legislation. Both unqualified attested titles require context selection. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-f8cd6f41ad0b28ca.text: ану-ын үндэсний байгаль орчны бодлогын хууль
alternates: хүрээлэн буй орчны талаархи үндэсний бодлого
term-f8cd6f41ad0b28ca.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/HDY-3-2022-11-15.pdf ; https://www.uih.mn/upload/sudalgaa/files/450_5845627.pdf ; NLI 2022 journal PDF page 95; Parliament Secretariat 2009 collection PDF page 266, bilingual NEPA table. Cross-checked two Mongolian legal research sources. Corrected the obvious missing soft sign in байгаль and restored the US qualifier from the section. The alternative parliamentary title is context-gated. These are names of the US federal statute, not a generic national environmental policy. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-9992b3e808908a2c.text: ану-ын ховордсон ургамал, амьтны тухай хууль
term-9992b3e808908a2c.source: https://content.lavote.gov/docs/rrcc/documents/mongolian.pdf ; https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/HDY-3-2022-11-15.pdf ; Los Angeles County official Mongolian glossary PDF page 44, federal Act; compare distinct California Act on page 17 and NLI 2022 PDF page 95. The official glossary distinguishes the unqualified federal Act from California’s separately named state statute. NLI independently names the US protection law. Added the US qualifier; broader titles require confirmation. The California statute is not silently routed as the federal Act. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-4623de4bdbd6c923.text: nepa-ийн байгаль орчинд нөлөөлөх байдлын мэдэгдэл
alternates: хөтөлбөрт байгаль орчинд нөлөөлөх байдлын мэдэгдэл
term-4623de4bdbd6c923.source: https://content.lavote.gov/docs/rrcc/documents/mongolian.pdf ; Los Angeles County official Mongolian glossary PDF page 90, programmatic environmental impact statement; page 44 distinguishes environmental impact report. Restored the base statement expression from the attested programmatic term and added the original dictionary’s NEPA qualifier. The unqualified expression and programmatic variant require reading/selecting the original NEPA definition. Environmental-impact assessment as a process and California EIR as another document are deliberately not imported as unconditional synonyms. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-2ff8018b02e33959.source: https://cccp.gov.mn/images/content/2dc5e7b46da9c2927fcc6d80fc3ef891.pdf ; WWF Living Planet Report 2022 Mongolian translation, PDF page 44 (printed pages 42–43); translator and original publication identified on PDF page 2. The original WWF/ZSL report explicitly connects excessive fishing pressure with fish populations’ inability to replace losses, matching the book’s replenishment-based definition. The fish qualifier is preserved; generic excessive hunting of terrestrial wildlife is not imported. Translation credited to NUM biology professor B. Boldgiv. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-d6901f54b21e3199.text: патентыг худалдах буюу лицензээр ашиглуулах замаар орлого олох
term-d6901f54b21e3199.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF pages 9, 37–39, patent sale and licensing income. Descriptive equivalent joining the two expressly discussed revenue methods, sale and licensing. The guide distinguishes full transfer for a sale price from retained rights and continuing licensing income. It does not mislabel patent valuation, filing or acquisition as monetization. The 2009 IPOM adaptation is used for terminology, not current filing deadlines or universal procedural rules. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-97fd68330fe5207d.source: https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/documents/guides/customization/inventing_future_mn.pdf ; PDF pages 42–44, patent-right enforcement and court proceedings distinguished from alternatives. Descriptive equivalent restoring the patent-right subject from the section heading. Pages 42–43 discuss enforcing rights, infringement claims and court-ordered compensation; page 44 expressly contrasts court litigation with arbitration and mediation. The expression is confined to judicial proceedings, not every administrative patent complaint or out-of-court negotiation. The 2009 IPOM adaptation is used for terminology, not current filing deadlines or universal procedural rules. Independent legal-language review pending.

term-ce9c0186c9b3abde.text: нийтэд түгээмэл болсон тэмдгийн нэр хүндэд сэв суулгах
term-ce9c0186c9b3abde.source: https://ipom.gov.mn/source/Looking%20good.pdf ; PDF page 19, printed page 19; famous-mark protection and TM/registered-mark indicators. Source-supported descriptive expression for the reputational-harm branch of the definition. The guide discusses unrelated goods using the famous mark, rather than ordinary same-product confusion. Not asserted to be a standardized Mongolian name for the US dilution doctrine. Independent legal-language review remains pending. The historical guide supplies terminology evidence, not current legal advice.

Not asserted to be a standardized Mongolian name for the US dilution doctrine. Independent legal-language review remains pending. The historical guide supplies terminology evidence, not current legal advice.

term-cb02a7f16e3e6b69.text: барааны тэмдэг гэдгийг илтгэх TM тэмдэгт
term-cb02a7f16e3e6b69.source: https://ipom.gov.mn/source/Looking%20good.pdf ; PDF page 19, printed page 19; famous-mark protection and TM/registered-mark indicators. Source-supported descriptive expression for the TM indicator, distinguished from the registered-mark indicator. No registration right is inferred from TM. Independent legal-language review remains pending. The historical guide supplies terminology evidence, not current legal advice.

term-4a855161b7a80f65.source: https://ipom.gov.mn/source/Looking%20good.pdf ; PDF page 19, printed page 19; famous-mark protection and TM/registered-mark indicators. Source-supported descriptive expression for the registered-mark indicator. The source explicitly distinguishes it from TM and SM. Independent legal-language review remains pending. The historical guide supplies terminology evidence, not current legal advice.

term-be92f00ae3d34afc.source: https://journal.num.edu.mn/journalism/article/download/7185/6353/13498 ; PDF page 2, printed page 104; B. Bayarmaa, Internet photography copyright, NUM Journalism 16 (2015). The author explicitly pairs the Mongolian phrase with in public domain in a copyright discussion, and distinguishes it from merely posting a work online. The added subject бүтээл restricts this route to creative works rather than state property. Both original duplicate senses are retained. This historical terminology evidence does not certify current law. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-7056c0165def97a8.source: https://journal.num.edu.mn/journalism/article/download/7185/6353/13498 ; PDF page 2, printed page 104; B. Bayarmaa, Internet photography copyright, NUM Journalism 16 (2015). This historical terminology evidence does not certify current law. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-3df0b45cab31471b.source: https://journal.num.edu.mn/journalism/article/download/7185/6353/13498 ; PDF page 3, printed page 105; B. Bayarmaa, Internet photography copyright, NUM Journalism 16 (2015). Descriptive equivalent of the explicitly named royalty-free permission. It describes repeated use without recurring payment, not copyright abandonment, a free initial purchase, or unrestricted use beyond the license. This historical terminology evidence does not certify current law. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-c62d422486cfa7fa.source: https://supremecourt.mn/mn/home?id=179&page=books&tp=detail ; Library entry 179, US administrative adjudication, paragraphs 2-3. Explicit bilingual designation in the Supreme Court library description of G. Munkhsaikhan, US administrative adjudication (2025). The surrounding text places the role within executive agencies rather than the ordinary judiciary. The primary expression corrects зуйн to зүйн; the literal source spelling is retained as a finite variant. Do not substitute захиргааны хэргийн шүүгч, which could denote a different judicial role. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-a77828c72c6adf1b.text: агентлагийн шүүхтэй төстэй шийдвэр гаргах ажиллагаа
term-a77828c72c6adf1b.source: https://supremecourt.mn/mn/home?id=179&page=books&tp=detail ; Library entry 179, US administrative adjudication, paragraphs 2-3. Source-supported descriptive expression for agency tribunal decision-making resembling a court. The paragraph expressly describes hearings, witnesses, evidence and independent decisions by agency tribunals. It does not relabel the agency as an ordinary court or imply that all administrative activity is adjudication. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-4b1e6b024cc5db19.source: https://nli.gov.mn/gariinavlaga/Gereenii%20erh%20zui%201.pdf ; PDF/printed pages 31, 32. Agreement of the contracting parties, not a party’s unilateral intention. Offer/acceptance supplies the book’s context; this route does not infer assent from silence. Independent legal-language review pending; historical terminology evidence, not current-law advice.

alternates: хууль зүйн хувьд хүчин төгөлдөр гэрээ
term-5b74deb19b37d959.source: https://nli.gov.mn/gariinavlaga/Gereenii%20erh%20zui%201.pdf ; PDF/printed pages 31, 82. The handbook connects legal validity with enforceable obligations and lists capacity, legality, agreement and form. The genitive source form is retained; no particular contract is certified valid. Independent legal-language review pending; historical terminology evidence, not current-law advice.

term-a690030276dc9d22.text: бодит үйлдлээр хүсэл зоригоо илэрхийлэн байгуулсан гэрээ
term-a690030276dc9d22.source: https://nli.gov.mn/gariinavlaga/Gereenii%20erh%20zui%201.pdf ; PDF/printed pages 66. Describes agreement manifested by conduct without spoken exchange. Does not equate implied-in-fact agreement with quasi-contract or the separately defined real-contract category бодит гэрээ. Independent legal-language review pending; historical terminology evidence, not current-law advice.

term-ef69e4faf0d54690.source: https://nli.gov.mn/gariinavlaga/Gereenii%20erh%20zui%201.pdf ; PDF/printed pages 34. Names the beneficiary person rather than the contract itself. Generic third-party references remain insufficient; the route retains the benefit-from-another-parties-contract context. Independent legal-language review pending; historical terminology evidence, not current-law advice.

term-8b80b9989843aa1e.text: гэрээний заалт тусдаа хүчин төгөлдөр байх
term-8b80b9989843aa1e.source: https://user.tender.gov.mn/uploads/contract/5fed65feb2889.pdf ; PDF page 42, SGS/IMME bilingual appendix, clause 13.7. Explicit bilingual Severability heading. The following clause preserves the remaining provisions when one provision or application is invalid. This is a contract clause, not merely a statutory partial-invalidity rule. Independent legal-language review remains pending; source is evidence of terminology usage, not advice that its provisions apply to other agreements.

term-23f2de6b294d191b.source: https://user.tender.gov.mn/uploads/contract/5fed65feb2889.pdf ; PDF page 40, SGS/IMME bilingual appendix, clause 10.4. Descriptive expression for an actual provision specifying a termination circumstance. Clause 10.4 permits termination after prolonged force-majeure prevention. The bare cancellation expression is not assigned exclusively to this entry. Independent legal-language review remains pending; source is evidence of terminology usage, not advice that its provisions apply to other agreements.

term-01863d62067271fd.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail?lawId=299 ; Article 68.1-68.4; corresponding English article 68. Describes subsequent principal approval after an unauthorized representative acts. Treaty ratification is a different sense. No jurisdiction-specific approval deadline is imported into the dictionary. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

The broader transaction expression requires confirmation; both original duplicate contract entries remain selectable. Procedures are not asserted identical across jurisdictions. term-01cd71fd9b11d87d.source: https://www.mining.sandvik/siteassets/general-documents/download-center/terms-and-conditions/2024-terms-and-conditions-of-supply-mongolia-english.pdf ; PDF page 5, clause 11.5, read with page 6 clause 12.3. This is a source-supported descriptive pathway for the book claim against a person liable for a death, rather than the criminal offense of homicide, all bereavement, or a claim that every death creates liability. Requires civil death-compensation claim context; no foreign standing rule or Mongolian damages formula is imported. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-c4eefc111b3fad69.source: https://nhrcm.gov.mn/pdf/bcb5768d58bc78b0954a612124932e04.pdf ; Human Rights Commission training guide (2023), PDF/printed page 8. The commission guide uses this expression for the environment created by insulting, threatening or bullying conduct in its discussion of discriminatory workplace harassment. The accusative ending is removed from орчинг for a headword. Requires harassment/discrimination context, excluding merely an unfriendly workplace or normal disagreements. The source does not establish an identical legal threshold in every jurisdiction or collapse the environment into an individual act of harassment. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending. The source surface form орчинг is retained for search recognition, without certifying it as the preferred normative accusative spelling.

term-1fb19462ab91861e.source: https://nli.gov.mn/pdf/turiin_alban_tushaaltan.pdf ; National Legal Institute public-official liability study, section 1.4.3, PDF 12 / printed 305. The study describes the court declaring rights, status and legal relationships independently of restoration or compensation, clarifying otherwise uncertain legal relationships. This matches the book court statement of rights and obligations and is broader than the rejected patent-scope-only dictionary lead. Requires court/right-declaration context, not a declaratory claim, announcement or political proclamation. The historical study is terminology evidence, not a claim that its old comparison of available Mongolian remedies is current. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-7c35c5c542f14fcd.source: https://www.icrc.org/sites/default/files/external/files/ehl/ehl-mongolian-modules.pdf ; ICRC Exploring Humanitarian Law, Mongolian modules, PDF/printed 229 and context 197. The ICRC material uses this specific court expression in war-crimes-trial resources and explains courts established to try accused war criminals, including Nuremberg, Tokyo and later ad hoc tribunals. It identifies a court category rather than equating every international court or ordinary military court with a war-crimes tribunal. Nuremberg is an example, not a restriction of the unchanged generic English entry. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-9856f2d3bad80682.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HDY.2014.02.pdf ; O.Munkhsaikhan, Law Above All 2014 number 2, PDF 18 / printed 17, right column. The author explicitly pairs this expression with retributive justice and describes imposing punishment deserved for the crime/wrong committed, including a criminal-law example. This supplies the desert-based punishment sense in the book Retribution entry. Requires criminal-punishment-theory context, not private revenge, generic punishment, mere deterrence or restorative compensation. No mandatory eye-for-eye penalty or contemporary factual claim about the historical political dispute is imported. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-eb881f90dfbb766c.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/HDY-3-2022-11-15.pdf ; Law Above All 2022 number 3, PDF 94 / printed 94, Canadian environmental enforcement remedies; corroborated by 2016 number 4, PDF 119 / printed 117 footnotes 15-16. The 2022 journal explicitly pairs the Mongolian expression with Injunction. Its cited Canadian government enforcement policy distinguishes a court injunction stopping or preventing violations from enforcement-officer compliance orders. This is a documented pathway for the prohibitory sense used by the book construction-stopping example, not a claim that the word хориг alone expresses every mandatory injunction. Requires court-remedy context. The 2016 judicial article distinguishes Mandatory Injunction (ordering action) and Prohibitory Injunction (forbidding action); those types must not be conflated. No Canadian environmental penalties or Mongolian administrative procedural rules are imported into the original English entry. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-a0b0220a18f732aa.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/HDY.2019.01.pdf ; J.Oyuntungalag, Purpose of Delict Law: Law and Economics Approach, Law Above All 2019 number 1, PDF / printed 15, conclusion continuing on 16. The author uses this exact past-tense verbal expression for breach of the duty of care in tort, discussing the legally required standard of caution, preventability and a snow-related vehicle accident. This matches the book failure-to-meet-the-required-standard-of-care sense, unlike a generic contract-duty breach or moral obligation. Requires tort/duty-of-care context. The attested verbal wording is retained rather than inventing a nominal Mongolian headword. The economic analysis is not asserted to establish an identical negligence test in every jurisdiction or automatic liability for any accident. Original English entry retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-c0aea3097c86038c.text: хэрэг маргааны нэг талыг байлцуулахгүйгээр нөгөө талтай харилцах
term-c0aea3097c86038c.source: https://www.mglbar.mn/resource/mglbar/File/2025/11/14/mazkac1vvxkeqpky/02.%D0%A5%D1%83%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%B9%D0%BD%20%D0%BC%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%B3%D1%8D%D0%B6%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B9%D0%BD%20%D2%AF%D0%B9%D0%BB%20%D0%B0%D0%B6%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%20%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BC%D1%82%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%85%20%D0%B4%D2%AF%D1%80%D1%8D%D0%BC.pdf ; Mongolian Bar Association, Code of Professional Conduct, PDF / printed 32, article 15.10 heading and 1-1.3; NLI Law Review 2019 number 5 English PDF / printed 36, footnote 62. The professional rule names communication by a judge with one party while excluding the other. The NLI English article expressly identifies the same article 15.10 as ex part [sic] communications with parties. Source heading comma removed and case normalized for search. Requires decision-maker/proceeding context: not every conversation between persons in a dispute. Absence in the Mongolian wording is not asserted to mean the excluded party necessarily lacked knowledge in every case; the original book specifically describes lack of knowledge. Preserve that distinction and the rule exceptions for notice/disclosure, consent and law; no claim that every such communication is illegal. The judicial formulation supplies a contextual pathway to the broader book decision-maker concept, not an assertion of identical US administrative hearing rules. term-645360b86fb88d04.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail/11705 ; Construction Law, Mongolian and parallel English articles 48.1-48.3 and 49.1-49.5 in the same portal page. The official portal parallel English text expressly renders ашиглалтын гэрчилгээ as certificate of occupancy; the full Mongolian building-certificate expression appears in 49.2. Commissioning verifies construction-permit conditions and design under 48.1, and the certificate is issued based on the commissioning conclusion under 49.1. Requires building-use/compliance context; no identical local US issuing authority or deadlines are implied. Article 49.2 also classifies existing-building certificates by quality/safety, including ones that fail requirements; the Mongolian certificate label alone must not be taken as proof that a particular building is currently safe or legally suitable for occupancy. Original book compliance/suitable-occupancy meaning retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-9627fb7aedb0a3c1.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/HDY-3-2022-11-15.pdf ; A.Bodibileg, shareholder meeting challenge rights and limitations comparative study, Law Above All 2022 number 3, PDF / printed 209, paragraph beginning Өөрийн үг үйлдлээсээ and footnote 39; article begins 199. The author expressly connects this principle to English Estoppel in footnote 39, with an example of shareholders seeking to contradict their prior supporting vote after management relied on it. This supplies the book bar against contradicting previous statements/actions; the exact source verbal expression is retained rather than inventing a nominal Mongolian headword. Requires legal inconsistency/reliance context, not a general moral injunction never to change one’s mind. Does not imply that every contradictory statement is legally barred, that all estoppel subtypes have identical elements, or that the article shareholder restrictions apply universally. In particular this route is NOT a verified translation of the separate Promissory Estoppel entries; promise-based detrimental reliance and enforceability require separate evidence. Original English content retained. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-851d99ad9c72d5a9.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HDY.2016.02.pdf ; E.Munkhdavaa, Мэдэгдэх ба сонсгох зарчим, Law Above All 2016 number 2, PDF 63 / printed 62, heading, introduction and footnotes 1, 4-7; discussion continues PDF 64-66. The author expressly grounds this notice-and-opportunity-to-be-heard principle in due process of law, cites the Fourteenth Amendment and Joint Anti-Fascist Refugee Committee v. McGrath, and explains notice and participation before adverse decisions. This supplies the precise notice/hearing fairness elements in the book Procedural Due Process definition. Requires fair-proceeding/legal notice-and-hearing context; not every notification or oral hearing. This is a documented core-principle pathway, not a claim that notice and hearing exhaust every procedural due-process protection. It is NOT mapped to Substantive Due Process, whose fundamental-right protection despite adequate procedure is distinct. The article material-law discussion concerns administrative decision procedure, not a verified translation of US substantive due process. No identical Mongolian/US requirements, exceptions or current legal advice imported. Original English content preserved. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-e7b4c41a910b3fd7.text: бусдын зөвшөөрөлгүйгээр хувийн эзэмшлийн газарт нэвтрэх
term-e7b4c41a910b3fd7.source: https://www.sbs.com.au/language/mongolian/mn/podcast-episode/can-you-pick-fruit-from-someones-garden/lfij5ly7q ; SBS Mongolian, 17 August 2026, Phil Tucak / presenter Khandmaa Ochir, key points and Jarrad Duggan municipal community-safety interview; English counterpart /language/english/en/podcast-episode/can-you-pick-fruit-from-someones-garden/o4tix52h4. Requires land/property-entry context and jurisdiction confirmation: not every infringement of property rights, no automatic damages or criminal intent/burglary requirement, and not the distinct Trespass to Chattels entry. Local lawful-access rules and permission/exceptions still matter; no claim that every entry without express permission is unlawful in Mongolia or every jurisdiction. term-dfa97a09599bea5e.source: https://nhrcm.gov.mn/assets/img/32721d884238a023ce6d0abf7d584168.pdf ; NHRC Human Rights quarterly 2004 number 2, Dr Lee Miong Ung, Эдийн засаг, нийгэм соёлын эрхийн зөрчлийг шүүхээр хянан шийдвэрлэх боломж: Бүгд Найрамдах Солонгос Улсын туршлага, PDF 45 / printed 46 paragraph 10-1; title/author PDF 43 / printed 44. Historical comparative Korean account, not a claim about current Korean or Mongolian statutory article numbers, universal notice duties, misconduct-only grounds, or identical US just-cause tests. term-1da4f38244dc9b19.source: https://ustr.gov/sites/default/files/uploads/gsp/asset_upload_file463_14831.pdf ; USTR Mongolian Generalized System of Preferences guide, scanned PDF 34 / printed 34, General guidelines for petitions; guide foreword PDF 3 identifies USTR and historic 2006/2008 context. NARA identifies Federal Register as the daily federal journal containing agency regulations, proposed rules and notices, matching the book. Requires US official-publication context: not generic federal registration, an immigrant registry, commercial incorporation or a database of personal records. The source is historical; old GSP eligibility dates and filing instructions are not current legal advice. Federal Register is distinct from the codified Code of Federal Regulations, and an informational website rendition is not automatically the official legal edition. Original English content retained; independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-b5102c17857f6aa1.source: https://etoli.mn/%D0%94 ; Mongolbank-UFE-FRC updated Economic and Financial Terminology Dictionary, public entry ID 3065 Sunset clause / Дуусах нөхцөл; provenance https://etoli.mn/about and named working group https://etoli.mn/workinggroup. Source expressly pairs Sunset clause with this Mongolian term and automatic legal expiry, matching the book Sunset Provision definition/example. Requires law/regulation automatic-expiry-clause context: not a generic contract end condition, ordinary expiry date or a deadline for insurance claims. Sunset provision/clause are the same legislative expiry mechanism here; no expiry date or renewal procedure invented, and no claim that every sunset clause has identical extension rules. Generic Mongolian wording therefore requires confirmation. Original English content preserved. Independent legal-language review remains pending.

term-eb41370805c93726.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail/11634 ; Criminal Code 6.3.2-6.3.4, especially offense-time incapacity and no punishment in 6.3.3; current public text rechecked 2026-10-17. The publisher uses automated localization and its body mistranslates the FLSA name and pay-rate rule; those errors are not adopted. Only its checked heading is used, with the IRS original and primary law controlling the legal scope. No tax deduction, occupational exemption decision or numeric salary threshold supplied. Independent bilingual employment-law review pending.

Mandatory separated/divorced-spouse financial-support context: temporary support to help the recipient spouse complete education or retraining and become economically self-sufficient, matching the original degree-completion example of Rehabilitation Alimony. This is the exact native heading of a comparative-law spousal-maintenance category; the heading alone also names ordinary educational activities. Confirm the financial-support sense before opening. Exclude scholarships, child maintenance, ordinary employee training, permanent dependency support, reimbursement for funding the other spouse’s education, and transitional relocation support alone. German1575 has marriage-related education-interruption and other specific conditions; do not import them as universal US rules. Massachusetts gives one statutory rehabilitative-support example, not nationwide eligibility/duration rules. No invented compound Mongolian alimony headword or numeric universal duration supplied. term-298b57ba10941db2.source: https://nli.gov.mn/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/HDY.2012.3.pdf ; https://www.leg.state.nv.us/NRS/NRS-111.html ; https://www.law.cornell.edu/wex/recording ; Ts.Davkharbayar, NUMSchoolofLaw civil-law senior lecturer/doctoral candidate as listed in2012, Үл хөдлөх хөрөнгө, тулгамдсан асуудал, Хууль дээдлэх ёс2012No3(38), printed104-105/PDF107-108 (PDFcontains duplicated pages); printed105 parenthetical registration of deeds. Mandatory US real-estate document-recording context: entering a deed or comparable property instrument into official public records to give legal notice of its contents, matching the original county-recorder deed example of Recording. Confirm this document-filing/public-notice sense. The native property-registration wording is broader and also appears in constitutive title systems, so it must not automatically resolve to US Recording. Exclude audio/video recording, generic business or loan databases, merely issuing a current ownership certificate, and treating entry as a state guarantee of title validity. NRS111.315 distinguishes notice to third persons from validity between the original parties;111.320 supplies the notice effect. Recording does not automatically cure defective title, and jurisdiction-specific priority rules differ. No historical1925claim, universal constitutive-transfer rule or identical Torrens/Mongolian legal effect imported. Independent bilingual property-law review pending.

Mandatory original-definition portfolio expiry/revenue context: a significant number of important patents expire around the relevant period, exposing the patent holder to a potential sharp revenue decline as generic or other competition enters. This matches the existing pharmaceutical-company example. Confirm this patent-cliff financial event, not a decline in patent filings, amortization of an intangible asset, falling patent quality, a stock-price drop for another reason, or any single routine expiry without the relevant revenue exposure. Patent expiry and regulatory exclusivity are distinct; not every expiring patent immediately permits generic launch, and overlapping rights, litigation or regulatory rules may delay entry. The original definition says potentially: no automatic guaranteed loss or company forecast is asserted. Only the bilingual terminology and expiry/revenue mechanism are adopted; stock recommendations, prices, projected earnings, investment advice and listed-company accusations are excluded. term-19cb8dac710c424e.text: олон нийтийн орчинд ая тухтай, хэвийн тайван байдлыг алдагдуулах
term-19cb8dac710c424e.source: https://sudalgaa.gov.mn/download/probatsiyn-yl-azhillagaa-erkh-zyn-zokhitsuulalt-khartsuulsan-sudlal-65e ; https://law.justia.com/codes/california/code-civ/division-4/part-3/title-1/section-3479/ ; https://law.justia.com/codes/california/code-civ/division-4/part-3/title-1/section-3480/ ; CourtDecisionEnforcementGeneralAgency-commissioned UniversityofInternalAffairs probation comparative study, PDF/printed66 footnote49 explicit Public nuisance description; cover/foreword1,3 identify team led by B.Altangerel. CaliforniaCivilCode3479/3480 statutory text as republished by Justia.. Mandatory civil public-rights context: substantial interference with health, safety, public comfort or peaceful use of places/resources shared by the community or a considerable number of people. This public-comfort description is one branch of Public Nuisance, not its exhaustive translation; the original definition also illustrates public-road obstruction and river pollution and remains intact. Confirm the civil tort/public-rights sense, including a factory affecting community enjoyment, rather than merely criminal disorderly conduct or any unpleasant noise. A private-neighbor annoyance, personal injury alone, or generic disturbance is insufficient. California3479 includes health/comfortable enjoyment and public waterways/roads;3480 requires community or considerable-number impact. Public nuisance and criminal public-order liability may overlap but are not identical; civil standing, special injury and remedies depend on jurisdiction. No automatic criminal classification or assertion that every annoyance is actionable. Independent bilingual tort-law review pending.

Mandatory US private spouse-settlement context: a written agreement between spouses separating or planning to separate, settling their separation terms, including property, custody or support, while divorce may be contemplated. This source-attested broader divorce-issues agreement title supplies a context-qualified descriptive search pathway to Separation Agreement; it is not certified as the sole standard translation. Confirm the private agreement and separation-settlement sense, not a divorce petition, divorce judgment/certificate, automatic dissolution of marriage, prenuptial contract or generic property sale. Signing alone does not divorce the spouses, and an agreement is not universally required for separation. Custody/support terms remain subject to applicable law and child-welfare review. The source court particular payment amounts, party identities and foreign/Mongolian formalities are not imported into the existing English entry; NorthCarolina formalities are not universal US rules. Mandatory original-entry share-control investor context: an investor acquires or seeks a large shareholding to gain control and change corporate management or strategy, often against incumbent management, potentially profiting through restructuring, resale or takeover-related transactions. Confirm this Corporate Raider sense, matching the existing management-overhaul example. The native financial glossary is narrower in mentioning resale/attempt profit; these illustrate rather than exhaust the original definition. Exclude an armed raider, theft, coercive illegal asset seizure, generic corporate crime, passive shareholding and every ordinary purchaser or activist. The label itself does not establish illegality or that all shareholder activism is a raid. No automatic requirement that every acquisition ends in asset stripping, no guarantee of profits and no outdated tender/merger monetary threshold imported. Independent bilingual corporate-law review pending.

Mandatory US adverse land-possession context: acquiring title through actual open continuous possession for the applicable statutory period under the relevant jurisdiction conditions, with an adverse claim inconsistent with another title claim rather than mere owner permission. This statutory Mongolian heading is a broader source-attested acquisition-by-possession description, not a declaration that Mongolian Civil104is equivalent to US Adverse Possession. Confirm the US adverse-possession sense. Mongolian104ownerless-property, good-faith and registration conditions differ and must not be imported. Do not assume land is abandoned merely because neglected, that tenancy/permission alone creates adverse title, or that elapsed time alone suffices. Exclude adverse possession as a route for movable-property finding, inheritance, purchase, prescriptive easement only, generic possession or mere preferential purchase rights. Texas10-year illustration is not a universal limitation period or complete account of all exceptions; state-specific elements, title claims, disabilities and remedies vary. The original English definition and example remain intact. Independent bilingual property-law review pending.

Mandatory US 35 USC111(b) provisional filing context: an unexamined application that can establish an early effective filing date for supported subject matter in a corresponding later nonprovisional filing, and allows Patent Pending notice. It is not an issued temporary patent or an enforceable patent right. Ordinarily a corresponding filing claiming benefit is needed within12 months; limited restoration procedures are not a routine extension of provisional pendency. No merits examination or automatic patent grant occurs. Exclude temporary post-publication protection, PCT filing, trademark filing, issued patent, nonprovisional application and generic temporary petitions. The two original synonymous English records remain separately retrievable with unchanged definitions and examples. Independent bilingual patent-law review pending.

Mandatory US constitutional substantive-due-process context: judicial protection of certain fundamental rights or liberties from government interference even when procedural safeguards are present. This is an attested Mongolian phonetic borrowing from parliamentary speech, not independent certification of a single standard Mongolian legal headword. Confirm substantive rather than procedural due process. Exclude a mere hearing or notice defect, generic fair-trial right, criminal limitation-period material/procedure classification, administrative convenience, or eminent-domain compensation alone. Do not equate Mongolian Constitution16.14with every US Fifth/Fourteenth Amendment doctrine, assert that every claimed liberty is fundamental, or that every agency action violates a fundamental right. Glucksberg did not recognize the asserted assisted-suicide right; its majority analytic distinction is cited, not a claim that all modern rights questions are settled by that case. Original agency-review example remains intact. Independent bilingual constitutional-law review pending.

term-2a2e57142df07945.text: хөдөлмөрийн хамтын маргааныг хөдөлмөрийн арбитраар хэлэлцэх
term-2a2e57142df07945.source: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail/565 ; https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/363/574/ ; https://www.fmcs.gov/services/arbitration/ ; Actual historical1999LabourLaw3.1.9and118heading/118.1-118.6, not current2021interest-dispute rules; actual Steelworkers v.Warrior&Gulf363US574(1960), Court opinion575-578; actual FMCS Arbitration and Arbitrator Roster introductory paragraphs.. Mandatory US existing collective-bargaining-agreement context: arbitration of employer/employee or union disputes over the interpretation or application of agreed terms, including the original working-conditions example. Confirm this rights/grievance sense. The native heading is a broader historical collective-labour arbitration activity description, not certification of a single standard translation or identity with Mongolian procedure. Exclude negotiating new contract terms or interest disputes alone, ordinary mediation, generic commercial arbitration, an individual employment grievance without the relevant collective agreement, and court appeal of an award. The historical Mongolian118recommendation and acceptance mechanism is not imported as the US award effect. FMCS provides rosters and panels; independent arbitrators, not FMCS employees, decide awards. Arbitrability and scope depend on the agreement and applicable law; not every workplace complaint is automatically arbitrable. No old domestic time limits or current-law procedural advice imported. Original definition/example unchanged. Independent bilingual labour-law review pending.

term-8dbb2ee9b9788c91.text: захиргааны хэм хэмжээний актын төсөлд санал авах
term-8dbb2ee9b9788c91.source: https://nli.gov.mn/www-legalinfo-mn-%D1%86%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%BC-%D1%85%D1%83%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82-%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%8B-%D1%85%D1%8D%D0%BC-%D1%85%D1%8D%D0%BC%D0%B6/ ; https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/5/553 ; https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/410/224/ ; Actual National Legal Institute notice2023-01-11, heading and both body paragraphs, E.Tserenduzee; actual5USC553(b)-(c); actual Florida East Coast Railway410US224(1973), majority opinion240-245.. Mandatory US APA notice-and-comment rulemaking context: agency adoption of rules after notice of the proposal and an opportunity for interested persons to submit written data, views or arguments, without the formal on-record trial-type hearing under553(c),556and557. Confirm this US procedural sense before opening the original definition and example. The source phrase describes the public-comment activity and is broader than a certified translation of the whole doctrine; Mongolian Article62 is not imported as identical US procedure. Exclude Formal Rulemaking, individual adjudication, mere notice of a final rule, parliamentary bill consultation, and generic public opinion collection. Informal does not mean legally unofficial or invalid. An oral presentation can occur without converting the process into formal rulemaking; do not claim that informal procedure categorically forbids all hearings or that every administrative rule must use notice/comment despite statutory exceptions. No Mongolian consultation deadline imported into US law. Original English definition/example unchanged. Independent bilingual administrative-law review pending.

term-38c1b7d2df8022b2.source: https://journal.num.edu.mn/NLR/article/download/10744/9335/22257 ; https://www.law.cornell.edu/wex/express_contract ; https://www.courts.state.md.us/data/opinions/coa/2004/85a03.pdf ; T.Mendsaikhan, NUM Law Review27(77),2026,47-67, DOI10.22353/nlr.2026.01.03; PDFpage5/printed51, sectionII.A(1); Cornell Wex actual definition and implied-in-fact distinction; Stern v Board of Regents dissent PDFpage45, expressly identified as dissent quoting earlier Dashiell definition.. Mandatory express-contract context: parties actually declare their mutually agreed contractual terms explicitly in words, orally OR in writing (or both), rather than a contract inferred only from conduct. Confirm this class before opening the existing English definition and example. This is a context-qualified express-agreement descriptor derived transparently from a reliable native scholarly contrast, not certification of a standard Mongolian headword. A signature or writing alone is not the classification; oral explicit agreements remain included, subject to applicable legal formalities. Exclude implied-in-fact contracts, quasi-contract, generic intention, an offer before acceptance, and agreement inferred solely from conduct. Do not map the unqualified word тохиролцоо or general шударга ёс to this subtype. Original manuscript unchanged. Independent bilingual contract-law review pending.

Additional dative form attested in the indexed localized conveyancing article, closing documents / miscellaneous documents / insurance policy paragraph, inspected2026-10-18.. Mandatory real-estate title-defect insurance context: cover for losses arising from defects in legal ownership/title. Confirm this meaning before opening the original definition and example. Exclude physical property-damage insurance, life insurance, mortgage-default insurance, construction warranties and a registrar liability policy. Published localization supports this contextual route; independent bilingual legal review remains pending.

term-1b8a6f6ef4354172.text: Нотлох баримтын бүрдэлд үндэслэн журам батлах албан ёсны сонсох ажиллагаа

term-b6d3c51eb70d6238.description: Талуудын эцсийн тохиролцоо болсон бичгэн гэрээг зөрүүлэхийн тулд өмнөх тохиролцоо эсвэл нэгэн зэрэг хийсэн аман тохиролцоог нотлох баримт болгон ашиглахыг, зөвшөөрөгдөх онцгой тохиолдлоос бусад үед, хориглох дүрэм. Бүх тохиролцоог бүрэн агуулсан бичигт нийцсэн нэмэлт нөхцөлийг ч хасаж болно. Гэрээ тайлбарлах болон хуульд зөвшөөрсөн бусад тохиолдлыг үгүйсгэхгүй.

term-824e2daf326b440d.description: Шилжүүлэгч нь хүчинтэй өмчлөх эрхтэй, шилжүүлэх эрхтэй бөгөөд өмчлөх эрхийн доголдол, бусдын өрсөлдөх шаардлагаас хамгаалах баталгаа гаргаж үл хөдлөх эд хөрөнгийг шилжүүлэх баримт бичиг. term-4c77fb4ab622dfcf.description: Үл хөдлөх эд хөрөнгийн эрх шилжүүлэх баримт бичигт тусгасан, хөрөнгийг хэрхэн ашиглахыг хязгаарласан хувийн нөхцөл. term-09afe6295c7dd4be.text: Ёслолгүй боловч хуульд заасан нөхцөлөөр хүлээн зөвшөөрөгдөх гэрлэлт
term-09afe6295c7dd4be.description: Ийм гэрлэлтийг зөвшөөрдөг харьяаллын хуулийн шаардлагыг хангаснаар ёслол хийлгүйгээр үүссэн хүчинтэй гэрлэлт. Тухайн үедээ гэрлэсэн хос болохыг харилцан зөвшөөрөх, бусдад гэрлэсэн хос гэж танилцуулах зэрэг шаардлага байж болно. Зөвхөн хамт амьдрах нь хангалтгүй бөгөөд Монгол Улсад бүртгэлгүй хамтран амьдрахтай шууд адилтгахгүй.

term-a5decbb48cf6542f.text: АНУ-ын хүүхдийн асрамжийн харьяалал ба шийдвэр хэрэгжүүлэх тухай жишиг хууль
term-a5decbb48cf6542f.description: Хүүхдийн асрамжийн шийдвэрийг аль мужийн шүүх гаргах, өөрчлөх эрхтэй болон бусад мужийн шийдвэрийг хүлээн зөвшөөрч хэрэгжүүлэх журмыг зохицуулсан, АНУ-ын мужуудын хууль тогтоомжид нэвтрүүлэх жишиг хууль. Зөрчилтэй шийдвэрээс сэргийлж, шүүхүүдийн ажиллагааг уялдуулна. Холбооны хууль биш.

term-95a18fc79de2e938.text: Хуульд хориглоогүй хүрээнд үндэслэлгүйгээр цуцалж болох хөдөлмөр эрхлэлт
term-95a18fc79de2e938.description: АНУ-ын at-will зарчмаар ажил олгогч, ажилтан аль аль нь хөдөлмөр эрхлэлтийг ерөнхийдөө дурын үед, шалтгаан нотлохгүйгээр, урьдчилан мэдэгдэлгүйгээр дуусгаж болно. Гэхдээ хууль, гэрээ болон хүлээн зөвшөөрсөн онцгой нөхцөлийн хязгаарлалт үйлчилнэ. Хууль бус ялгаварлан гадуурхалт, хариу арга хэмжээ авахыг зөвшөөрөхгүй.

term-e559fab060282f65.text: Шинэ бүтээлийг бодитоор хэрэгжүүлэх буюу мэдүүлгээр хэрэгжүүлсэнд тооцох
